description: Run multiple pippin commands concurrently in one call. Use this to fan out (e.g. fetch mail + calendar + reminders simultaneously) instead of sequential tool calls. Each entry's response is its own envelope. An entry must be a command that has an MCP tool of its own (same flags as the CLI); batch and job run cannot be nested, and anything else returns a per-entry error.

confirmToken.description: Only after a confirmation_required error: the confirmToken it returned, with the same arguments, to carry out the call.

dryRun.description: Check the call and report what it would do, without doing it.

entries.description: Array of {cmd, args} entries: each runs as `pippin <cmd> [args...] --format agent`.

args.description: Argv tail passed to the sub-command (e.g. ["list", "--account", "icloud"]).

cmd.description: Top-level pippin subcommand (e.g. mail, calendar, reminders).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A repeat of this key with the same arguments within 24 hours returns the first result with replayed=true and does nothing.

title: batch: arguments
